prompt:
Subject: enlargement, target meaning "拡大".

Composition: A photographer uses a darkroom enlarger to project a small photographic negative into a visibly larger image on paper beneath it, with no labels or text.

Style: Use references/invidious.png for style only: thick rounded dark-brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D shapes, restrained cartoon shading.

Framing: One compact composition filling 80–90% of the square; keep all subjects complete. No decorative frame, pedestal, or floating ornaments.

Output: 512×512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and gaps. No text, letters, numerals, speech bubbles, labels, branding, or watermark.
Style reference invidious.png only: rounded friendly 2D cartoon, thick dark-brown outlines, flat colors, restrained shading. In a darkroom, a photographer uses an enlarger to project a small negative into a visibly larger image on paper below.
en: The enlarger produces a larger photographic image.
ja: 引き伸ばし機で小さなネガを大きな写真に拡大しています。
